summary: Adds shadcn/ui primitives to the desktop renderer (Tailwind 4 utilities without preflight or a default theme, scanned from src/renderer/components/ui only, with shadcn tokens mapped onto the existing theme variables) and uses them in two places: a Button that gives the composer's Stop, Queue, Steer and Send one height, and one promise-based AlertDialog confirm that replaces all 16 native window.confirm calls in the renderer with the same wording. The native alert blocked the renderer and could not be driven by Playwright; the in-app one is reachable by role and name.

reactNativeIos.reason: Every changed file is in the Electron renderer, its Vite config or the desktop e2e harness. apps/mobile does not import src/renderer, does not load Tailwind or Radix (React Native has no DOM for them), and has no window.confirm to replace: its destructive prompts already use React Native's Alert.alert, which is non-blocking.

nativeAndroid.reason: apps/android is a Compose app with its own dialogs and composer; it shares no renderer code, CSS or components with the desktop, and no file under apps/android changed.

sharedBackendApi.reason: No IPC channel, event, wire frame or src/shared file changed. Every confirmed action calls the same window.api method as before, with the same arguments, after the user answers.

storageDataMigration.reason: No schema, settings key or stored data change. The confirm queue lives in renderer memory only and is empty on reload.

updateRelease.reason: No package identity, signing, deep link or update channel change. The new dependencies (Radix, class-variance-authority, clsx, tailwind-merge) are bundled into the renderer by Vite; Tailwind and its Vite plugin are build-time only. build:fast and the post-build smoke test pass.

automated: npm run typecheck and npm test pass, including tests/unit/confirm-dialog.test.ts (resolves true on the action, false on Cancel, false on Escape, one dialog at a time with a queued second request answered independently).

SB_VISUAL_SCOPE=screens npm run test:e2e:visual passed twice in a row. The 18 baselines for chat, sidebar, command palette, provider picker, Settings and kanban match main's unchanged; only composer-running and approval (both show the running composer's buttons) were refreshed, and confirm-dialog was added, in all three themes.
grep -rn 'window.confirm' src/renderer finds only the doc comment on the replacement.
hardware: Every refreshed and new baseline PNG was opened and inspected by eye on this Mac (Apple Silicon) in Dark, Light and Translucent before commit.
notExercised: The behaviour phase (native glass transmission) was not run: it needs Screen Recording permission this session does not have. No translucency rule changed besides the reuse of the existing sb-floating-surface class on the dialog.
Only the remove-project confirm is driven end to end in e2e; the other 15 call sites are covered by typecheck and by sharing the one helper.
Mobile and Android were not exercised; no files there changed.
